Overview

A guided group tour across three countries. See the temples and markets of Bangkok, the ancient Angkor Wat in Cambodia, the old streets of Hanoi and the islands of Ha Long Bay. A tour manager from Mumbai travels with the group, so you never have to worry about the details.

Tour highlights

  • Tour manager from Mumbai with the group
  • Bangkok Grand Palace and Wat Arun
  • Pattaya Coral Island speedboat trip
  • Sunrise at Angkor Wat, Bayon and Ta Prohm
  • Hanoi Old Quarter and water puppet show
  • Overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Bangkok, transfer to Pattaya

Fly from Mumbai to Bangkok. Meet the group and drive to Pattaya. Evening Alcazar show.

  • Dinner
Day 2 Coral Island

Speedboat to Coral Island for beach time and optional water sports. Evening at leisure.

Day 3 Pattaya to Bangkok

Drive to Bangkok. Afternoon city tour with Golden Buddha and Marble Temple.

Day 4 Bangkok temples & river

Visit the Grand Palace and Wat Pho, then a long-tail boat ride to Wat Arun. Evening Chao Phraya dinner cruise.

Day 5 Bangkok to Siem Reap

Fly to Siem Reap, Cambodia. Evening at Pub Street and the night market.

Fly to Hanoi, Vietnam. Evening water puppet show and walk in the Old Quarter.

What's included
